pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with smooth edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank are larger and more elongated, while those on the lower hindquarters are smaller and more rounded in geometry.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily three-way intersections. The thickness of the pathways is relatively constant throughout the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A jagged 1D geometric contour along the dorsal neck and shoulder with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, non-conforming silhouette with a distinctive orange-red pixel cluster is situated on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck.
